elaine: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR that consolidates the Optimize toolkit examples for batching + KV prefetch and adds a Go SDK snippet for prefetch config. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 :wave:

matt: copying the PR — will skim now. Is this the one that also renames the quant profile to `q4-dyn-range-v2`? I remember a convo about naming.

elaine: yes — I renamed the profile for clarity. Also added a short note about short-sequence streaming edge cases where prefix caching can hurt latency.

samir: nice. Can you paste the Go snippet here? want to make sure it matches our actual SDK API before I review. :eyes:

elaine: sure — it's intentionally minimal, example shows enabling KV prefetch + batch window. I ran `make docs-preview` locally, layout looks ok.

elaine: ```go
// example: prefetch + microbatch config (redwood-go-sdk v0.4)
import (
    "context"
    "time"
    rw "github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go-sdk"
)

func configure(ctx context.Context, client *rw.Client) error {
    cfg := rw.OptimizeConfig{
        Prefetch: true,
        PrefetchWindowMs: 20,
        Batch: rw.BatchConfig{MaxTokens: 1024, MaxLatencyMs: 15},
        QuantProfile: "q4-dyn-range-v2",
    }
    _, err := client.Optimize.Apply(ctx, "my-service", cfg)
    return err
}
```
